title: 129th Rescue Wing - Soaring Angel 2014
description: California Air National Guardsmen from the 129th Rescue Wing host Soaring Angel, a collaborative tactical-training exercise at Moffett Federal Airfield, Calif., Oct 2-5, 2014. During Soaring Angel, personnel from the 129th RQW conduct joint operations, satisfying their tactical training and readiness requirements through multiple live scenarios during the multi-day exercise in a simulated deployment environment at Moffett Federal Airfield, Fort Hunter Liggett, and San Clemente Island, California.
keywords: pararescue, ANG, California Air National Guard, United States Air Force, USAF, 129th Rescue Wing, personnel recovery, guardian angel, MC-130P combat shadow, Soaring Angel, search and rescue, HH-60G Pave Hawk
